entries.brief: Silver open palm releasing three warm gold four-point sparks; blessing of courage and fortune, not healing; broad painterly shapes, upper-left warm light, transparent background, no text or UI.

Matching pair of moss-green supple calf boots, leaf-shaped seams and copper-brown fastenings, thin brown soles, no wings; painterly warm upper-left light, transparent background.
Deep-red cabochon pendant in aged warm silver with two leaf-shaped supports and short chain loop; robust vitality, no medical cross or blood; painterly warm upper-left light, transparent background.
